name: ns_proofsearch_pressure_channel_taxonomy
rubric_version_reason: Successor after ns_proofsearch_residual_defect_packet_certificate found exact zero-defect Beltrami/shear packets whose pressure-channel profit vanishes. This rubric targets the remaining weak node: pressure-channel universality on boundaryless T^3, or an admissible evader with pressure-active source and residual control.
description: Bounded theorem-search substrate for classifying admissible pressure-channel profit functionals on T^3, or constructing a pressure-active residual-stable packet evading the Beltrami/shear nullity obstruction.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-attempt substrate over pressure gauge, pressure-Poisson reconstruction, packet residual control, and ratchet profit admissibility.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden, admissibility, and counterexample quality, not formula gaps.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The previous run found exact decaying Beltrami/shear packets on boundaryless T^3 with R_n=0 and Defect_n=0 but zero pressure-Poisson source, hence zero gauge-invariant derivative/zero-mean pressure-channel profit. Your task is not to repeat that result. Attack the remaining weak node: either prove a taxonomy showing admissible pressure-channel profit on T^3 must be gauge-admissible and incremental/derivative-normalized, hence null when [p]=[0]; or construct an admissible evader. A valid evader must not be a gauge artifact, not a velocity-only mechanism mislabeled as pressure, and not a boundary/forcing mechanism unless it explicitly changes scope. If you leave the null packet family, pay the full stack: nonzero pressure-Poisson source, projected NSE residual R_n, strain budget A_n, residual-defect ratio, sign coherence, cycle profitability or exhaust margin, and return-time density/summability. Penalize regularity/blowup overclaims and any argument that treats pressure constants as physical without a gauge-fixing rule.

criteria.Pressure_Channel_Eigenquestion_Disciplin: Full credit requires attacking the actual weak node exposed by the residual-defect packet run: pressure-channel taxonomy on boundaryless T^3, or an admissible evader. Restating the Beltrami/shear null result alone is insufficient.
criteria.Gauge_And_Pressure_Reconstruction_Discip: Full credit requires treating pressure as a gauge class modulo constants, using the Poisson reconstruction -Delta p = partial_i partial_j(U_i U_j), and keeping the boundaryless T^3 assumptions explicit.
criteria.Functional_Taxonomy_Or_Counterexample_Qu: Full credit requires either a real taxonomy theorem for admissible pressure-channel functionals or a mathematically admissible pressure-profit mechanism outside the prior null class.
criteria.Packet_And_Residual_Interface: Full credit requires explicit packets U_n and controlled divergence-free compatibility, projected residual R_n, strain budget A_n, and residual-defect ratio whenever the submission leaves the null Beltrami/shear packet family.
criteria.Sign_Profit_And_Cycle_Stack: Full credit requires pulling forward sign coherence, pressure-channel gain, cycle profitability or exhaust margin, scale progression, and return-time density/summability instead of assuming downstream ratchet layers.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a concrete theorem packet, admissible evader, no-go taxonomy, Lean-facing objects, or next discriminator with hypotheses, conclusion, and proof skeleton.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Anti_Overclaim: Reject regularity/blowup overclaims, pressure-gauge artifacts, velocity-only mechanisms mislabeled as pressure channels, and boundary/forcing mechanisms that do not explicitly change scope.

success_criteria: A taxonomy theorem: admissible pressure-channel cycle contributions on boundaryless T^3 reduce to gauge-admissible incremental pressure functionals that vanish when [p]=[0].

An admissible evader: a pressure-channel profit functional or packet family outside the prior null class, with gauge rule, nonzero pressure contribution, and no boundary/forcing/velocity-only laundering.
A pressure-active packet certificate: explicit U_n with nonzero pressure-Poisson source, controlled R_n/A_n/Defect_n, sign-coherent pressure gain, and cycle/return obligations.
A first-blocking-node theorem showing why one of the above routes is impossible or must pay a sharper PDE burden.
failure_modes: Restating the Beltrami/shear null test without addressing universality or evasion.
Using pressure values or means as physical observables without fixing the pressure gauge.
Calling a velocity-only, boundary-driven, or externally forced mechanism a pressure-channel mechanism without explicit scope change.
Treating approximate packets as exact NSE dynamics without projected residual and strain estimates.
Claiming Clay-level regularity or blowup from a local taxonomy or packet result.
